enumHelp.description:
EnumHelp says in a line what each enum value means, for choosing one:
setup lists them, the Settings window shows the selected one's.

notImplemented.description:
NotImplemented marks a setting declared ahead of the feature that uses it:
it can be set, but has no effect yet.

backend.description: Backend is the llm.backend it applies to; empty: every backend.

alsoBackend.description:
AlsoBackend is another llm.backend it applies to, for some routines
(llm.local.url: claude-api's local/<model> routines).

valueText.description:
ValueText and DefaultText are the values written the way `settings set`
takes them ("" when unset), for frontends to show and send back as is.

inactive.description:
Inactive says why the setting has no effect now: it's for another
llm.backend than the one in use.

title: procauto settings get --json
description: State is a setting with its effective value.
